title: Tesseract OCR Studio
summary: Full-page German/English OCR with HD/4K webcams, OpenCV perspective extraction and manually adjustable curved-book-page dewarping using genuine remap, Leptonica/Tesseract LSTM and native SDL2/ImGui.

applications.name: tesseract-ocr-studio
applications.summary: Native DirectShow camera, image ROI/perspective extraction and optional curved-book-page remapping, German/English language modes, frozen-frame OCR and readable text previews.
